cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first formal CLI invocation used PYTHONPATH=. and imported the installed workbench package from the v1.8.6 worktree, which lacked the current context-pack API; the immediate retry also placed its event draft outside the repository-relative file boundary.
impact: The required event append was initially blocked until the current worktree backend and a repository-relative event draft were supplied.
lesson: Invoke formal development control with the current worktree backend on PYTHONPATH and keep event drafts repository-relative until the CLI consumes them.

cause: The focused post-estimation projection tests executed the real workflow without replacing the deployment-owned host resolver with an explicitly admitted test endpoint, so the runtime correctly failed closed with WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_HOST_ENDPOINT_REQUIRED.
impact: All three scoped projection tests were blocked before reaching their post-estimation assertions.
lesson: Real workflow tests must admit a deployment-owned host endpoint through the explicit supervisor seam before execution.

cause: After host admission was supplied, the legacy source fixture exposed a noncanonical artifact index and the real model workflow rejected it before execution could persist its branch.
impact: The scoped tests still failed at the canonical model branch source artifact registry boundary until the current workflow-runtime fixture helper was reused.
lesson: Real workflow fixtures must register source artifacts through the current canonical artifact-index helper before execution.

cause: The scoped pytest command passes but the installed Starlette/httpx compatibility layer emits one StarletteDeprecationWarning.
impact: The focused assertions are green, but the command output is not warning-free; dependency cleanup remains outside this bounded test migration.
lesson: Report pre-existing dependency warnings separately from the scoped host-boundary test result.

cause: The first focused-green gate event draft used not_applicable for preventability, but the formal event contract permits only the controlled preventability enum.
impact: The green gate append was rejected once and required a corrected event draft before formal closeout could continue.
lesson: Validate every formal event enum against the CLI contract before treating a gate append as recorded.

cause: The scoped post-estimation projection tests complete through the explicit deployment-owned host admission seam.
impact: The three scoped projection tests pass without changing production endpoint resolution or accepting caller-controlled authority.
lesson: Keep the host-admission seam explicit in every real workflow projection test and retain full backend/provider/host acceptance as separate gates.

cause: The bounded test migration, focused test gate, event-chain verification, and required scope checks are complete.
impact: The formal line closes at its scoped green boundary; full backend regression and production provider/host acceptance remain separate known gates.
lesson: Close a development line only after its bounded evidence and formal event stream are verified.
